title: Google's AI Transcriber: 18¢ An Hour. Microsoft's: 54¢.
description:
Gemini 3.5 Transcribe lists $0.003 per minute (about $0.18/hour, Google's estimate; the Live version is $0.005/min). Microsoft MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming is $0.54/hour, introductory through the end of 2026. Sources: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, microsoft.ai/news/our-first-streaming-transcription-model

AI-generated visuals and voice. #Shorts #AI #AItools
